_readme: Where each page's first chart begins, in CSS pixels from the top of the document at
1440x900. The house rule is that a reader meets evidence in the first screen; a page
that opens on 1,800px of prose has broken it, and until 2026-08-28 fifteen of sixteen
pages had, with no check looking.
This file is a RATCHET, not a target. A page listed here may only improve: the gate
fails if its first chart moves further down than the number recorded. Pages fixed to
the rule carry the LIMIT (900) rather than their measured value, so they cannot drift
back. A page NOT listed here must clear 900 outright, which is what makes this safe
The unfixed numbers are debts, recorded honestly rather than hidden behind a
threshold nobody meets. Lower them as pages are fixed.
